label: Franken
research: The undated catalogue abstract includes damage to Hessian subjects by Hans von Rosenberg among military matters; it gives no seat, kin, office, or date for that item. Hans of the Bauland Franken family is a possibility, but neither the Hessian setting nor the common name distinguishes him from other bearers. Attribution remains unresolved. The Marburg catalogue dates HStAM, 2, 89 as a whole to 1500–1518. It gives no individual date for the Rosenberg complaint. The other topics in the file do not identify who suffered the damage or link the complaint to a specific feuding Hans. https://arcinsys.hessen.de/arcinsys/showArchivalDescriptionDetails.action?archivalDescriptionId=1926847
